claims.claim: WithRerankProvider builds a rerank provider from a ProviderSpec; unknown types fail with the registered types named; a provider file with role rerank declares the same
Supported types voyageai and cohere, with API keys from VOYAGE_API_KEY and COHERE_API_KEY
Nothing in the pipeline calls the reranker; RerankProvider returns the provider, and an error when none is configured
RerankRequest fields Query (required), Documents, TopN (zero means all), Model; empty Documents returns empty result; empty Query is an error
Results ordered best first; Index is the position in Documents; Score not comparable across providers; MaxDocuments reports per-call limit
RerankProvider returns the first declared, RerankProviderByID returns by ID or errors listing IDs, RerankProviderIDs in declaration order
